faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (ICMR NIRWoH), Mumbai for a project-based position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Technical Support – II (Social Worker) under advertisement number PTS-II/061026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support – II (Social Worker) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th in Science with a Diploma in Medical Social Work OR possess a Three Years Graduate degree in Medical Social Work.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support – II (Social Worker) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 26,000/- per month, which includes Rs. 20,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 14th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email before this date.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their prescribed application form along with required documents to [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of all submitted applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates, followed by a physical interaction or online interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location is at the ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health located at J M Street, Parel, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400012.
